$comment: White-label branding, applied at build time. Edit and rebuild to rebrand. Both fields can be overridden per-build with the ACP_UI_BRAND_NAME / ACP_UI_BRAND_ICON environment variables. `icon` is a path relative to this repo root and must stay inside it: it is inlined into the bundle as a data URI, so remote URLs are rejected by design (see README, White-label branding).
